rationale: The agent appears to have located the user via name/zip and accessed two orders, but then executed order-changing writes—modifying an item (exchange) and updating the shipping address—without first confirming with the user. There is no explicit confirmation step before the modify_pending_order_items and modify_pending_order_address calls, which violates the policy requiring confirmation before any write. Additionally, the agent did not provide a clear final summary of the changes or confirm any payment impact for the exchange. Evidence that the selected replacement item is the cheapest green variant is not established (only one product lookup is shown). The final message is a generic goodbye without confirming outcomes. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the policy.
